critical_code_review_comments: test_cycle_run_increments_detected accepts a no-op cycle (no new detections) when market is flat in a single 90s window — this matches reality but means the test only proves /cycle/run returns 200 and does not regress counts. If you want a stronger guarantee that the lab logger actually writes rows, consider adding a deterministic synthetic-signal path or a direct count-from-Mongo assertion on strategy_lab_log doc count delta.

Public reports view shows 'Need ≥20 resolved signals before a promotion verdict is issued' — promote_threshold is returned by /api/research/strategy_lab (=20). If you later tune this in env, ensure the footer copy is sourced from the API field, not hardcoded, otherwise UI and threshold can drift.

Both /api/research/strategy_lab and /api/research/strategy_sandbox are publicly readable. That matches the 'public read-only' model, but be aware /research/* aggregations can be expensive — the OOM-fix projections cover summary/funnel/missed; verify summarize_strategy_lab() likewise uses projections + window caps (looks fine in code, just flagging for ongoing perf budget).

FRESH START button gating is purely client-side (localStorage TOKEN_KEY presence). The actual security is enforced server-side (403 verified), but a logged-out user with the right localStorage key would still SEE the button — harmless because the API rejects it, but UX could mislead. Cosmetic-only.
